name: Glossy Toy Town
why: A toddler sing-along lives on bright, glossy, soft-shaded 3D-toy characters and round shapes — one bus, five friends, four colours — so every shot is a happy picture a two-year-old can name.
look: Saturated sky-blue days, candy-green hills, a cream bus with rainbow stripes; every shape is a rounded, gradient-lit toy with a soft highlight and big sparkly eyes. Words pop in as chunky outlined bubble letters.
elements: a cream bus with rainbow stripes and a smiling grille
five round-faced characters (toddler, bunny, duckling, frog, bear)
motion: Everything bounces: springy pops on the word, gentle squash-and-stretch idles, hard cuts between shots.
